articles.title: At least 15 attackers exploited Coldcard vulnerability: Galaxy
articles.snippet: Galaxy said that at least 15 different attackers have exploited the Coldcard vulnerability, which may have been avoided with just $2 worth of AI hardening, according to Dragonfly’s managing partner.

articles.title: Coldcard Bitcoin theft tops $100M across 3 confirmed attack waves: Galaxy
articles.snippet: Galaxy Research said 90% of the stolen Bitcoin remains unmoved as investigators examine a suspected fourth wave that could lift losses to $130 million.

articles.title: Boltz pauses service after wave of AI-assisted hacking attempts
articles.snippet: The non-custodial protocol said attackers are discovering and adapting exploits faster than its small development team can identify and patch them.

articles.title: Crypto Privacy Tools Serve ‘Essential Protective Functions’: Report by ChangeNOW, CoinRabbit
articles.snippet: Authoritarian oppression, corporate treasuries and “wrench attacks” make up the privacy case in a new report from ChangeNOW and CoinRabbit.

articles.title: Morning Minute: The Coldcard Bitcoin Hack Nears $114 Million in Potential Losses
articles.snippet: Self-custody is under attack, and it's becoming increasingly clear that AI is one of crypto's leading threats.
